newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: IBCA UPGRADES PICK 'N PAY LONG-TERM RATING.
newsitem.headline: IBCA UPGRADES PICK 'N PAY LONG-TERM RATING.

text.p: Rating agency IBCA said on Monday it had upgraded retail chain Pick 'n Pay Stores Ltd's domestic long-term rating to A+ from A previously and reaffirmed its short-term A rating.
It said the long-term rating had been upgraded to reflect the lower business risk profile and consequently low expectation of investment risk arising, it said in a statement.
This followed the initial positive effects of restructuring and refocusing undertaken in recent years, it said.
In addition, the group's sources of income had been diversified through the collection of franchise fees and the group's imminent entry into the financial services market later this year.
IBCA said these initiatives would enable Pick 'n Pay to resume its superior record of earnings growth in future.
